notes.title: Update 6/01/2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
Fixed a minor pathing issue in Osiris where NPCs could walk onto one tile of the tailor shop wall.

QoL Improvements
Emanation now displays the proper icon.
States that raise or lower your Attributes now list the % in the battle status screen.

Game Balance Changes
Blessing of Tantalasia now protects against Ensnare.

notes.title: Update 3/03/2025
notes.content:
A huge shoutout to Euphoniac for the extensive bug report in our discussion forum! Thanks to your detailed feedback, I was able to track down and squash some tricky, hard-to-find issues, making The Great Gaias even more polished. Your support means a lot, thank you!

Bug Fixes
Can no longer skip the Orgard camp trigger by walking south.
Can no longer skip the 2nd dialog trigger in the Celestial Realm.
Can no longer skip Lost Cove trigger by navigating mountains.
You can no longer leave the Necromancers area without collecting the Necromancers Gem.
Removed old pre-release text event in Alme.
The Orgard Teleporter inside the Sorbithian Lexicron now works as intended.
If Gerard teaches Atrius Mug it will no longer take 10,000 gold off your party.
Players should no longer be able to duplicate Pots’ Legendary gear.
Players can no longer get a duplicate of Armans’ Helm.
Tharonar will no longer appear in the Spire of Whispering Wind after the Battle of the Blighted Lands.
You can no longer escape the Azrael fight in Orgard if you approach him.
You can no longer bypass the second Valdraek fight wipe by equipping Rings of Rebirth.
You can no longer press the shift key to enter the small boat (canoe).


QoL Improvements
Added Immunity text over enemies (who are immune) when player tries to apply status ailments.
Elaenia will now remove all her equipment when selecting that option in the TGG Map.
Adelle and Laeni now have their names properly appear in the Osirian Arena if they are unlocked.
Added more landing locations for the Airship.
Optimized the Quest Journal code to reduce stuttering on longer questlines.
Cleaned up some cutscene animations when it comes to NPC fading.
Added Valdraek dialog to give a warning to players that they will be stuck in Ilbed after purchasing the Sea Chart.

Game Balance Changes
Lowered the AP cost of Full-Sunder from 100 to 60.

notes.title: Update 2/27/2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
Fixed an instance where the players could kill Grindelwald faster than his forms could change.
Fixed a potential issue with high refresh monitors and how exp fills the victory screen gauge.
Corrected a window placement in the item screen that could cover up the 4th party members portrait.
Adjusted word wrap placement of description text in crafting window.

notes.title: Kickstarter Pre-Announcement!
notes.content:

We are proud to announce the coming arrival of our Kickstarter for the Codex Eternal: Campaign Setting, the homebrew tabletop experience that gave life to The Great Gaias and Gjallarhorn. Be sure to subscribe to learn of new updates and news regarding our progress!

What to Expect:

From the time of our adolescence there was nothing quite like visiting the local hobby store to check out new miniatures, supplemental compendiums and boxed sets of glorious campaign settings filled with a treasure trove of characters, maps and dice sets. We are returning to our youth with this project and hope to deliver a nostalgic product that reminds you of nothing short than those trips to your local gaming store.

Includes:

Our Kickstarter reward tiers will include our entire digital collection of video games and soundtracks as well as our new physical campaign setting box set.

notes.title: Major TGG Update and HE News!
notes.content:
The Beta Branch has finally been thoroughly tested and we are taking it now to the main build branch!
We will be attending PAX East 2023 going on from March 23rd to the 26th so if you are heading there, please drop by our booth and say hello! While showing off The Great Gaias and Gjallarhorn at PAX we will also be holding a raffle for our new cloth map!
Besides finishing up this huge update to The Great Gaias we’ve also completely revamped our website www.horizonsend.com so be sure to check it out and please subscribe to our mailing list because we have some big announcements coming soon!
 
Changelog:

Bug Fixes
Losing internet connection will no longer close the game
Removed old file checks that could sometimes cause an error
Osirian Pirate will no longer sit at his desk on the lower floor when breaking free
Removed redundant quest ping sound effects from multiple locations
When inspecting Thief Door music will no longer skip
Multiple Gravestones can now still be read after collecting a shard from them
Singing Nuns will now ignore the player when talked to
Removed old sleep balloon graphic from Halladen Guard
Fixed a soft lock that can happen under rare circumstances when entering Orgard Thief Guild in Ch.5
Dragon Disciple Sneak Attack now works as intended
Corrected various dialog errors
When Furi and Quathorn join the group you will no longer have to reset the party if trying to add them right away
Ledonel now has proper gear equipped when playing “Visions of the Past”
Alahanyu will no longer flash when moving backwards
You can no longer walk on the windows inside the Church of Illyria
Backed out of choosing a Difficulty Selection will now return you to the Title Screen
You can now talk to the Seamstress from behind the counter in Thedorado
Corrected a single tile light stream that couldn’t be walked over


QoL Improvements
When talking to Vassis during the night you will no longer have to keep walking up to her if you want to discuss more topics
Added a Leatherwork to the city of Frosthammer
Added a sparkle to Cyrus’ Notebook for better visibility 
Removed redundant rest times while Furi works on the farm
If you kill Thule Overlord while using only Wein it will now end the conflict
The Celestium Sword now has a unique appearance 
You can now return the Naerish Rope to Dr. Gentile at anytime except during Dark Farlen


Game Balance Changes
Added Holy Weakness to some demons that didn’t have it
All roads on the world map should now have a zero encounter rate
Waterworks encounters have had their experience increased slightly
New City Recruit spawns have been increased by 25%
You can now steal Essence of Fire from all Fire Elementals
You can now steal Essence of Water from Water Elementals
You can now steal Essence of Lightning from Lightning Elementals
You can now steal Essence of Earth from Earth Elementals
Soravendite will now always drop a Soravendomas Branch
Ethereal Silk drop rate has been slightly increased


Content Additions 
Steam Overlay is now enabled
Updated some balloon pop-ups
Sense Evil has been added to Wein (Paladin) and will increase on use to bypass random encounters. For the skill to be added to an old save just enter the Book (The Great Gaias) and exit. This will teach Wein the skill.

notes.title: Engine Update
notes.content:
We’ve just created a Beta Build branch for The Great Gaias.
It has updated engine features which should prevent the horrible desktop crash when internet loss happens. While we believe this update shouldn't have any negative side effects to the game, we are not 100% positive that there could be some unforeseen issue that crops up from it. Because of this we decided to make it a beta branch before introducing it into the main build branch of the game. If you right-click on The Great Gaias and go to "properties" you can select "Betas" and find this build on the list. Not only should this fix the internet loss crash, but it should also allow Steam Overlay to work properly. 
Again, this build has not been tested yet. I'm going to slowly test a playthrough myself before releasing it into the main build branch. I wanted to make an announcement here in case anyone has been thinking of playing or replaying The Great Gaias. If so, I would much appreciate it if you played it on the Beta Build so more testing can be done.

notes.title: Gjallarhorn Phase 1 Closed Beta
notes.content:
Gjallarhorn Beta

Phase one of our Gjallarhorn closed beta is underway! 
From balancing to bug fixes there has been a lot of feedback from our testers. We are patching the game weekly and are working hard to make sure Gjallarhorn will have the smoothest launch possible once it is ready for release. 

If you haven't already wish listed Gjallarhorn be sure to do so and if you are interested in joining a future phase of our closed beta than please join our Discord where we will be making announcements on beta recruitment once phase 1 is done.

In the meantime, while you wait for Gjallarhorn why don't you refresh your memory of the lore by playing The Great Gaias!

notes.title: The Great Gaias Major Update - Chapter rework and Difficulty System - Big Sale
notes.content:
Horizon's End is offering The Great Gaias for the lowest price ever in hopes to promote social distancing! The sale begins at 10AM PST on April 13th and will last all week!

What better way to spend your time alone than with a (100+) hour old school JRPG? Not only have we lowered our price, but we have also crafted some new features including difficulty levels and a reworking of Chapter I. We have spent the last few weeks on The Great Gaias to address a few issues that have been on our plate for a while, many of which were based on the feedback we've received from the community. We have taken the constructive criticism from our fan base into account and we hope that the new difficulty system and our AI balancing will help bring in new players to enjoy this epic tale!

We haven't said much about Gjallarhorn, but rest assured, all the art and music has already been completed and we are in full production mode. It's moving along nicely, and we can't wait to show you what we have been working on! 

With the current situation, Horizon's End, would like to wish everyone good health and safety while we combat this global crisis. We hope that life will return to normal soon, as we were hoping to have our demo ready for PAX West, but in the meantime, please be safe, play The Great Gaias, enjoy the story... and remember, where the horizon ends, the journey begins!
